q: What It Takes to Make the Stay

r: Delight our guests: Bring an upbeat and friendly attitude to all guest interactions and proactively look for ways to make their meal experience special

d: Jumeirah, a global leader in luxury hospitality and a member of Dubai Holding, operates a portfolio of 29 exceptional properties across 11 countries in the Middle East, Europe, Asia, and Africa. In 1999, Jumeirah changed the face of luxury hospitality with the opening of the iconic Jumeirah Burj Al Arab and since then the brand has become known for its distinguished beachfront resorts, esteemed city hotels, and exclusive branded residences. Jumeirah is synonymous with Arabian luxury hospitality and the ability to craft distinctive, purposeful experiences for the world’s most discerning travellers.

Located on the pristine beaches of Bahrain’s West Coast, the resort features stunning ocean views, verdant greenery, and meandering waterways with modern, spacious rooms and suites as well as an exclusive Gulf Summer House, located directly on the beach. Guests can enjoy a variety of water sports activities, the resort’s five pools, and book treatments at Jumeirah’s signature Talise Spa.
q: The ideal candidate for this position will have the following experience and qualifications:
At least 3 to 4 years Bartending/Mixologist experience (preferably within the international hospitality industry).
Proven experience as a Mixologist, Senior Bartender, or similar role, preferably in a luxury hotel, resort, restaurant, or high-end bar.
Strong knowledge of spirits, liqueurs, wines, bitters, syrups, fresh ingredients, and cocktail techniques.
Demonstrated experience in cocktail menu creation and beverage program development.
Good understanding of beverage costing, inventory management, and stock control.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
Ability to work effectively under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
Relevant bartending/mixology certification is an advantage.
r: An opportunity has arisen for a Head Mixologist to join our Food and Beverage Team in Jumeirah Gulf of Bahrain. The main duties and responsibilities of this role:
Identify and meet guests’ needs, provide appropriate bar services, and assist guests in recommendations, upselling where appropriate to provide knowledgeable and bespoke service
Lead and supervise bartenders and bar staff during daily operations.
Create, develop, and maintain innovative cocktail and beverage menus.
Establish and maintain recipes, specifications, garnishes, and presentation standards.
Ensure consistency and quality of all cocktails and beverages.
Train and coach bartenders on mixology, service standards, product knowledge, and responsible alcohol service.
Monitor beverage inventory, stock levels, wastage, and product quality.
Assist with purchasing and maintain good relationships with suppliers.
x: We offer an attractive tax-free salary, paid in Bahraini Dinar (BHD), the local currency of Bahrain. In addition, we offer reduced hotel rates across our properties globally, excellent leave and health care package, flights home, accommodation, life insurance, 50% discount off Jumeirah F&B Outlets and reduced hotel rates.

d: The Head of Finance role within a fast-growing securities entity requires expertise in accounting, finance and treasury to lead financial operations and strategy. This position involves overseeing financial planning, consolidation, reporting, and regulatory compliance to support the group's business growth. This role reports to the local CEO and the Group CFO.
q: At least 10 years solid experience in audit and securities firms and knowledge in financial industry products
Degree Holder in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline.
Professional accounting qualifications such as CPA, ACCA, or an equivalent certification.
Strong knowledge of accounting and reporting standards
In-depth knowledge and experience in handling local capital adequacy rules is a MUST.
Proven leadership and team management capabilities, with the ability to mentor and develop high-performing teams.
Strong sense of business acumen, analytical, communication and reporting skills;
Mature, agile and demonstrate a positive mindset
Proficiency in computer literacy, ERP platforms, open-minded mindset in embracing AI, new-gen accounting and control system
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
Good command in both spoken & written English is a MUST. Mandarin speaking is an advantage.
r: Oversee all financial operations, including financial reporting, regulatory reporting, expense control, tax, treasury.
Ensure the capital adequacy is in compliance with local financial regulations and standards.
Lead and build a local finance team to handle, financial reporting, management reporting to support strategic decision-making.
Oversee the financial control function of the entity.
Support regional and group finance reporting requirements.
Monitor treasury management and cash activities, including cash movement, liquidity and financial planning to support the company’s expansion
Monitor daily liquid capital adequacy ratio and preparation of regulatory reporting.
Manage financial audits and liaise with external auditors.
Oversee cash flow management and optimizing financial performance.
Supervise and mentor the finance team to enhance productivity and skills.
Developing and implementing financial policies and procedures.
System development, devise user requirement, UAT for systems
Collaborating with other departments to align financial goals with business objectives.

d: Job Title: Total Rewards & Policy Specialist
Reports to: Head of Rewards & Organizational Development (Nakilat)

Review and update QFAB’s HR policies and procedures, to ensure their alignment with leading practices, as well as their proper implementation. Support the development and implementation of the rewards strategy, policies, and procedures, as well as overall QFAB’s rewards schemes. Ensure QFAB’s rewards strategies are equitable, transparent, and competitive enough to attract and retain the best talents to support the company towards achieving its business objectives.
q: Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Human Resources or any other related field.
A certification in a relevant discipline from an accredited institution (e.g. CIPD, PHR, SPHR, CIR, ACIR), is highly preferred.
5 - 7 years of related experience of which a minimum of 3 - 5 years should be in a similar position / responsibility
Previous experience in the Oil & Gas industry and regional experience is preferred
Extensive knowledge of organizational development principles and best practises.
Extensive experience in Rewards (designing grading structures, salary scales, bonus schemes, conducting salary benchmarks etc.
Extensive experience in Job Evaluation methodologies (knowledge of HAY methodology).
Working knowledge of HRM-ERP systems, preferably SAP.
Develop and update HR policies and procedures in compliance with Labor Law.
r: Participate in developing , reviewing, and updating all HR policies and procedures in coordination with the different HR Sections and ensure their implementation
Advise managers and employees on the interpretation of QFAB’s policies and procedures for consistent application.
x: Participate in designing and implementing QFAB’s rewards strategies, rewards structures, policies, and procedures in collaboration with Head of Rewards & OD and relevant stakeholders as appropriate.

Design, review and maintain QFAB’s rewards schemes against suitable benchmarks and make recommendations to ensure QFAB’s rewards schemes are both equitable and competitive enough to attract and retain required talents.
Partner with the Head of Rewards & OD to develop and conduct salary surveys to benchmark QFAB’s rewards schemes against leading organizations in the region.
Conduct Job Evaluation under the supervision of the Head of Rewards & OD for newly designed job titles and place them into the adopted grading structure at QFAB.
Coordinate with the Employee Relations Section — Recruitment Unit and company leadership to identify the starting salaries and most appropriate packages for the new hires.
Maintain and update job grading systems and pay scales to ensure internal equity.

Develop and update company's grading structures through applying appropriate Job Evaluation techniques whether in-house or through external consultants to build the right base for the salary structures.
Participate in carrying out studies to determine employees' satisfaction in terms of rewards.
Review queries related to incentive and reward schemes, as well as pay levels and structures, and take appropriate measures to resolve escalated cases.
Advise managers and employees on the interpretation of QFAB’s rewards strategies and related policies, procedures, and benefit programs.
Respond professionally and accurately to written and oral inquiries for QFAB’s employees regarding rewards-related matters.

Liaise with the Learning and Development section to implement and execute the outcomes/results of the performance management process, as it relates to merit increments, bonuses, promotions, salary adjustments etc.
Prepare reports and statistics related to salaries and rewards as required.
Analyze compensation and benefits data to identify trends, disparities, and areas for improvement.
Generate detailed reports and presentations for senior management to support data-driven decision making.
